system.description: You conjure pure spiritual energy to blast up to five undead, demons, and creatures of similar ilk of level 2 or less within short range. If you succeed on a separate Intellect attack against each foe, you choose whether they spend their next turn fleeing or lose their next turn. Effort: Increase the maximum level of the foe you can affect by 1. Specify some other action for the creatures to perform for one round, such as attacking a foe of your choice. Last action.
